markers.title: Placeholder date leaks into copy
markers.body: The body text literally reads "Ensure transactions are accurate by dd/mm/yyyy." — an unformatted template placeholder, repeated across three cards. Replace with a real formatted date before this goes in front of stakeholders.

markers.title: Three identical notifications in a row
markers.body: The same title, body, timestamp (10:14 am) and hotel (The Ecofern Hotel) repeats three times with no distinguishing detail, so the list reads as a data bug rather than three separate events. Add a unique identifier (invoice #, amount, staggered time) to each so they're scannable as distinct items.

markers.title: Expand chevron too small to tap
markers.body: The disclosure chevron on the "4 New reservations created" rows measures only ~16×18dp, well under the 44×44dp minimum touch target. Extend the tap area to the full row, which is what the chevron visually implies is tappable.

markers.title: 'Payments' filter chip clipped at screen edge
markers.body: The last filter chip is cut off by the viewport edge with no fade/gradient or arrow hinting the row scrolls horizontally, so users may assume the filter list ends there.

markers.title: Unlabeled eye icon for mark-all-read
markers.body: The floating circular button shows only an eye glyph with no text label. An eye conventionally means "view/preview," not "mark as read," so its purpose is ambiguous — add a label/tooltip and an accessible name for screen readers.

working_well: Notifications are grouped into clear "Today" / "Earlier" sections, aiding fast scanning.
Unread items get a colored accent background plus a colored dot, so state isn't conveyed by color alone.
The end-of-list message ("That's all the notifications you have for the last 90 days.") avoids the list feeling cut off or broken.
worth_considering: Add an unread-count badge to the bottom-nav bell icon so users can gauge volume before opening the screen.
Consider a "clear all" / collapse-read control so users don't have to scroll through 90 days of already-read items.
Show a count badge on each filter chip (e.g. 'Billing (2)') so staff can triage by category without switching tabs.
